name: icu Date toLocaleString dateStyle timeStyle and timeZoneName
source: function main(): void { const d = new Date(Date.UTC(2024, 0, 15, 13, 5, 9)); console.log(d.toLocaleString("en-US", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short", timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("en-US", { dateStyle: "full", timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("de-DE", { dateStyle: "long", timeStyle: "medium", timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("en-US", { timeStyle: "long", timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { timeZone: "America/New_York", timeZoneName: "short" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "Asia/Tokyo", timeZoneName: "long" })); }
